final_decisions: v1 collection is passive. Zeek logs and normalized flow CSV are primary inputs; raw PCAP parsing is delegated to mature capture/parsing tools rather than custom packet parsers.
Every record is explicitly Observed, Derived, Inferred or Analyst-authored. Inference is never stored as observed fact.
ClickHouse is the telemetry/time-series analytical store; PostgreSQL owns projects, schemas, model registry, incidents and analyst decisions.
TelemetryEnvelope v1 has schema_id/version, source, event_time, ingest_time, provenance, privacy labels and deterministic event identity.
First detector is a deterministic robust statistical baseline. First ML detector is Isolation Forest, versioned behind DetectorProvider; supervised XGBoost requires separately approved labeled data.
FeatureSchema v1 is immutable. Models bind to exact feature schema, training-data fingerprint, code version, threshold and evaluation report.
CI uses synthetic/generated datasets only. External datasets require license/privacy/redistribution review before repository inclusion.
Evaluation uses time-aware splits where chronology exists, duplicate/leakage checks, per-scenario metrics, calibration/threshold documentation and drift monitoring.
Explainability distinguishes exact deterministic drivers from model explanation approximations; the UI labels confidence/provenance.
